mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tighter monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, reducing expected cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth, prompting monetary policy tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending and business investment, accelerating corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to predict positive returns with Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive return rate in triggered instances is < 50%.
